summary: 60 Degrees Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K on November 5, 2026, disclosing inducement letters with existing warrant holders covering 584,492 shares. Holders agreed to exercise existing warrants (original strikes $7.60–$27.60) at a reduced $0.90 per share for gross proceeds of about $526,042.80. In exchange, the company issues new unregistered warrants for 1,168,984 shares (200% of exercised shares) at $0.90, exercisable after Nasdaq stockholder approval. This is a warrant-inducement financing, a US equivalent of a discounted capital raise, not a change-of-control event. Watch dilution and stockholder approval timing.
